flows.title: Create a contact
steps: Go to the Contacts section in the left sidebar and select the Contacts tab.
Click + Add in the upper right corner, then select Create new contact.
Fill in the contact's details in the form that opens. Emojis are removed on saving, a contact holds up to 20 secondary phone numbers and email addresses, and its notes up to 30,000 characters.
Click Save to create the contact.

flows.title: Edit a contact
steps: Go to the Contacts section from the left sidebar.
Find the contact with the search bar or by browsing the list, and click it to open their details.
Click Edit contact in the upper right corner of the contact card.
Update the fields and click Save. Changing the primary phone number unlinks the contact from its conversations, which stay available without the contact's name.
A contact synced from a CRM can be edited here only by an admin, and is better edited in the CRM itself.
